title: Persist prospect intake and sales follow-up as Kanbus issues
description:
As a salesperson I want contact and demo requests to become prospects so I can own their next follow-up.

Feature: Prospect lifecycle
  Scenario: Record marketing intake
    Given a configured brand contact or demo link
    When a valid request is submitted to Prospectus
    Then a prospect issue is created using Kanbus and Virtuus
    And source, contact, owner and follow-up are retained after reloading
  Scenario: Progress a prospect
    Given a qualified prospect with a salesperson
    When the salesperson advances an allowed funnel stage
    Then the persisted issue and embedded board show the new stage
    And invalid transitions are rejected
